<explanation>
Technical Q&A format establishing a pattern of URL examples with query parameters, expecting continuation of the second URL example.

The first URL example showed `?foo=1&flag=true&bar=2` with a question about parameter order/position, implying the second URL will contrast or demonstrate a specific case involving `flag` appearing alone or differently.

Final token `?flag` is the start of a query string in the second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), immediately requiring either `=value` or `&` continuation to complete the query parameter, mirroring the first URL's structure with `foo` and `bar` absent.
"Another URL" pattern: `https://example.com/?flag` expects a value or additional parameter like `=true` or `&something` referencing the "flag" mentioned earlier.
